firm_data.firm_description: Bamundo Zwal Schermerhorn & Caffrey, LLP is a New York City law firm with experienced litigators, trial lawyers, and transactional attorneys. They offer legal services in general practice, plaintiff's litigation, and defense litigation.
notable_facts: The firm traces its roots to 1975.
The firm has a combined experience of almost 200 years practicing law.

email.subject: AI for Bamundo Zwal Schermerhorn & Caffrey, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Steven,

With roots tracing back to 1975, your firm has built real depth across plaintiff and defense litigation. That institutional knowledge is your edge, and it's exactly what we see holding back adoption of generic legal AI tools.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of independent practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on discovery, document review, and litigation strategy.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
